summary: StudentDemographics is a user control for managing, displaying, and editing demographic information for a student within an ASP.NET web application. It provides UI elements for viewing and editing birth date, ethnicity, and citizenship, using dropdowns and text fields, with validation and session handling. The control uses forms, data binding, and modal popups for interaction, and its behavior adapts based on user permissions and session state.
purpose: To allow authorized users to view and edit specific demographic fields (birth date, ethnicity, citizenship) for a student record, with business logic for field visibility and editability, and proper session/user management.

workflows.name: Edit Demographics
steps: Switch to edit mode and show modal (mdlDetails)
Bind UI controls (uxDetail) to student data
User modifies fields: birth date, ethnicity, citizenship
On save (ItemUpdating), validate and parse input
Update values and call session-aware update logic
Redirect user to updated demographics page

business_rules: Edit button visibility depends on ScreenIsEditable and ReadOnly properties
Dropdowns for ethnicity and citizenship populated via Codes.CodeSearch with session context
On update, session parameter is required
If UserSession is null on selecting data, cancel operation
validations: Birth date input parsed and validated (DateFormatter.ParseDate)
conditions: ReadOnly disables editing but may show details
UserSession presence is required for data operations
system_behavior: Modal popup management for detail editing
Data binding on controls for display and update
Session management and redirect upon update
Client-side JavaScript variable setup for UI
exceptions: If UserSession is null, selection is canceled
If script manager is in async postback, different JavaScript registration is used
